traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Platanaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins dentate; veins usually palmate, sometimes pinnate; leaves deciduous; stipules present; plants monoecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in heads; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals or tepals; fruit achene or nut; stamens 3 to 4 (-7); carpels (3-) 5 to 8 (-9). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
